title: Reduce a fixed cosine actuator to Jacobi channels and force uniform low-mode escape
statement: For fixed i!=j and fibre n=k_i!=0,l=k_remaining, m=k_j, an orthogonal polarization change gives B_ij=P[cos(2pi x_j)partial_i]=i*pi*n*(J0 directsum Jrho). J0 is free bilateral Jacobi; rho_m=[r²+m(m+1)]/sqrt[(r²+m²)(r²+(m+1)²)],r²=n²+l². The exact source identity gives0<rho_m<1 andsum(1+|m|)|1-rho_m|<infinity. The source excludes square-summable eigenvectors by short-range interior recurrence asymptotics, norm control outside the band and strict coefficients at spectral edges. Invoking the explicitly named short-range Jacobi dispersion gives, for every fixed N, ||P_K exp(theta B_ij)P_N(I-Q_i)||<=C_N sqrt(2K+1)*theta^-1/3. Thus theta=q^10,K=q^6 yield O_N(q^-1/3) uniform escape of the ENTIRE low-frequency divergence-free space with k_i!=0. It is not merely a finite-Fourier invariant-space exclusion or one-datum simulation; numerical C_N need not be known to the subsequent certificate search.
